name: OVH
recent: OVH 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日召开特别股东大会，通过以 RM10.0 million 收购 Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd 全部股权（以 50,000,000 股新股支付）及业务多元化至建筑业的议案。10 月 26 日公告重大诉讼，11 月 6 日执行董事兼 CEO Willie Ho Huat Voon 在闭市期间减持 500,000 股。
notable: 股东在 2026 年 9 月 14 日特别股东大会上通过以 RM10.0 million 收购 Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd 全部股权，代价以 50,000,000 股新股（每股 RM0.20）支付。
股东在同一特别股东大会上通过业务多元化至建筑业及相关活动的议案。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 24 日根据员工持股计划（ESOS）发行 21,500,000 股新股，发行价每股 RM0.13。
risks: 公司于 2026 年 10 月 26 日公告重大诉讼。
执行董事兼 CEO Willie Ho Huat Voon 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日在闭市期间减持 500,000 股。
收购 Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd 以发行 50,000,000 股新股支付，将扩大股本。

recent_en: OVH held an EGM on 14 Sep 2026 and approved the RM10.0 million acquisition of the entire equity interest in Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd (satisfied via 50,000,000 new shares) and diversification into the construction business. On 26 Oct 2026 it announced a material litigation, and on 6 Nov 2026 Executive Director and CEO Willie Ho Huat Voon disposed of 500,000 shares during the closed period.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the RM10.0 million acquisition of the entire equity interest in Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd at the EGM on 14 Sep 2026, to be satisfied via 50,000,000 new shares at RM0.20 each.
Shareholders approved the diversification of the existing businesses to include construction and related activities at the same EGM.
The company issued 21,500,000 new shares under its ESOS at an issue price of RM0.13 per share on 24 Sep 2026.
risks_en: The company announced a material litigation on 26 Oct 2026.
Executive Director and CEO Willie Ho Huat Voon disposed of 500,000 shares during the closed period on 6 Nov 2026.
The acquisition of Bina Gemilang Bersatu Sdn Bhd is satisfied via the issuance of 50,000,000 new shares, which will enlarge the share base.
